title: RADD dictionary

name.description: Name of the system this dictionary serves, kebab-case, for example acme-orders.

formatVersion.description: The RADD dictionary format these files are written in. The dictionary's own version is the content hash computed by radd build.

locales.description: Locales with labels and messages in i18n/.

default.description: Default locale. Every key must exist in it; other locales fall back to it.

supported.description: Every supported locale, including the default.

databases.description: Database providers this dictionary must support. Database-computed fields need SQL for each.

extensions.description: CEL extension libraries expressions may use. Anything else fails lint.

defaultTtl.description: Expiry for lookups with cache: ttl and no ttl of their own.

locale.description: A BCP 47 language tag, for example en, fil or en-PH.
